sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "wine"."Appelation" AS e, "appellations"."County" AS g, AVG((CAST("wine"."Price" AS REAL) / "wine"."Score")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "wine" JOIN "appellations" ON "appellations"."Appelation" = "wine"."Appelation"  GROUP BY "wine"."Appelation", "appellations"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: wine.bottle price per critic rating score
why: bottle price / critic rating score: the catalogue declares bottle price a rate over critic rating score
average of bottle price per critic rating score per appellations within appellations.County
